input: A local frame-wrapped MXF original (read only), its index (qnc-mxf-index) and the frames of the part; a destination in the project folder.
output: The part as an MXF of the original kind: the header partition with its metadata (durations and the start timecode of the part), a new index (temporal and key frame offsets, slice offsets), the content packages from the intra picture at or before the IN (leading pictures of that group left out; sound, system item and data of each frame from its place in time) and a footer with the random index pack. Nothing decoded, nothing probed.
